1339-1940-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1940-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

301-2744-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

1580-2921-4871-6887.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1020-2866-3446-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Herald of Kozilek.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Herald of Kozilek.
Repeat.

338-2034-5086-5183-6441.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-2034-5086-5183-6441.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

4067-6281-6435-7013.easyPrerequisites: There are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
4067-6281-6435-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
4067-6281-6435-7013.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Coati Scavenger.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Coati Scavenger that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Coati Scavenger token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coati Scavenger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

1651-2499-3875-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2499-3875-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2499-3875-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3892-6968.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-6968.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

522-2111-3698.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3858-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has twenty or more charge counters on it
3858-6758.description: At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

631-2511-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
631-2511-6249--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2099-5362-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
You have enough mana to cast Quantum Misalignment
2099-5362-5365.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat from step 2.
2099-5362-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

586-4314-5258-5618-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pawn of Ulamog and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3284-4550-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3284-4550-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

678-1887-5296.description:
Cast Workhorse by paying {6}, causing it to enter the battlefield with eight +1/+1 counters on it due to Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until Workhorse has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Workhorse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

678-2292-5553.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2573-3946-4572.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

486-1543-2032-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Kiora has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
486-1543-2032-4312.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Kiora to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Kiora.
Activate Kiora by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1912-2585-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact attached to Grim Monolith.
Grim Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
1912-2585-4832.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2047-3888.notablePrerequisites:
Olivia's Attendants does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Olivia's Attendants.
2047-3888.description:
Activate Olivia's Attendants by paying {2}{R}, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Olivia's Attendants triggers, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Deal combat damage with Olivia's Attendants.
Olivia's Attendants trggers, creating six Blood tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

1061-1953-5134.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U}{U}{U} on your first turn, with {2}{U}{U} available on each extra turn
1061-1953-5134.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
1061-1953-5134.description:
Cast Fated Infatuation by paying {U}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Timestream Navigator token.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it and putting it onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 2.

2484-2615-3041.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
You have at leat fourteen life.
You have enough mana available to cast Blasphemous Act.
2484-2615-3041.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Blasphemous Act, dealing thirteen damage to all creatures.
Coalhauler Swine triggers, dealing thirteen damage to target opponent.

4621-4821.notablePrerequisites: You control nonland permanents that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
4621-4821.description:
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Guildmage's first ability by paying {2}{U}, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve the Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all nonland permanents by tapping those, adding at least {3}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
